name: Sapiom
description: Lets a platform's agent buy for each of its users with that user's own vaulted card, using UCP or browser checkout under per-card budgets. For apps whose agent shops for many users.

skills.name: Vault Users' Cards
skills.description: Sends each user a hosted setup link to save their card, so the agent can pay with it without ever seeing the card number.

skills.name: Check a Merchant
skills.description: Checks whether a merchant offers a UCP checkout Sapiom can drive, before the agent starts a purchase.

skills.name: Check Out on a Merchant
skills.description: Buys from one merchant with a user's saved card through a UCP checkout or a browser checkout page the agent completes.

skills.name: Set Agent Spend Limits
skills.description: Sets 30-day card budgets and optional spending limits so purchases within them go through without asking the user.
